items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: I just got a trill out of that, you know, the sound, you know, that harmony from that clarinet, you know. And it stayed with me.

ctx.x: And of course I had been playing violin and violin, but I didn't play the piano. So I, he was playing, he was playing that song about, that song, you know. And it went all through me, you know. I just got a trill out of that, you know, the sound, you know, that harmony from that clarinet, you know. And it stayed with me. See? I said, the last thing I'm going to do, I said, I'm going to learn how to play clarinet.
When was that you heard, George Backe?
